scenario: ResourceQuota exceeded — pod stuck Pending because namespace quota is full
query: worker-service pod never starts in staging
notes: Namespace 'staging' has a ResourceQuota capping CPU requests at 4 cores; 3.8 are used. worker-service requests 500m per replica: the replicaset controller cannot create its pods (FailedCreate, exceeded quota), so no pod exists and the Deployment stays at 0/2 with a ReplicaFailure condition. One cause (docs/case-audit-001.md, correction 2: the node-CPU Pending pod of the first version was a second cause). Fix: raise the quota or lower the requests.
